<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
register_device_transfer_provider(kind: str, provider: Callable) -> None
```

Part of [`evoxc.core`](/api/evoxc/core/)

Register the FLAT DEFAULT device-transfer provider for kind `kind`.

The legacy shared slot: populated by `evoxc.backends` at import time
(kind `"cuda"` → a lazy thunk over the iree adapter) and by tests
under made-up kinds. Re-registering a kind replaces the flat slot's
provider (last-wins WITHIN the flat slot only). Optional compiler
adapters must NOT use this hook — they register per-backend slots via
`register_backend_device_transfer_provider`, so activating one
backend can never clobber another's provider (order-independent).

`Tensor.to` resolves the PREFERRED backend's per-backend slot for the
target kind first (see `evoxc.backends.registry.get`), falling back to
this flat slot, then to a `DeviceError`.

## Parameters

- `kind` · `str` — Device kind the provider places data on (e.g. `"cuda"`).

- `provider` · `Callable` — Callable `provider(tensor, device) -> Tensor` receiving a
  host (ndarray-backed, `Device("cpu", 0)`) tensor and the target
  `Device`, returning a tensor placed on the target.

## Raises

- `TypeError` — If `kind` is not a non-empty string or `provider` is
  not callable.
